title: Group members
summary: The people in a group: joined members first, then pending invites. A tap opens the person's profile. An admin can remove someone.

membership.description: From RoomMember membership. Left, banned and knocking members are not listed.

isSelf.description: The person's own row, shown first with bipe_app_groups_you.

members.description: Joined (admins first, then by name), then invited.

confirmRemove.description: The user ID waiting for the remove confirm.

load.effect: Room.members, read in chunks with RoomMembersIterator.nextChunk, and the power levels.

remove.effect: After the confirm: Room.kickUser with no reason. A pending invite is withdrawn the same way.

notes: No ban, no role editor and no power level screen in phase 1 (client-rewrite-plan.md section 4: only what Bipe groups need).
A DM has no member list: its info screen shows the other person (ADR 0141). A DM that gained a third member is a group on every screen and shows this list.
Trust badges next to names follow trust UI (phase 2).
